{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of unique patient_id and total rows
print(f'Unique patient_id: {df["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Total rows: {len(df)}')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df["patient_id"].duplicated(keep=False)
print(f'Duplicate patient_ids: {df[duplicate_patients]["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check how many rows have biomarker_baseline == -999
print(f'Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check the cross-tabulation of arm and severity
print('\nCross-tabulation of arm and severity:')
print(pd.crosstab(df["arm"], df["severity"], margins=True))"}
